description: Every Cork API operation, plus cross-client risk attribution, exploitability-first triage, and stale-connector detection that a stateless API mirror cannot do.

novel_features.name: Score movement attribution
novel_features.description: Explain why a client's Cork score moved, broken out by claims, compliance, coverage, and vulnerability impact.

novel_features.name: Cross-client regression leaderboard
novel_features.description: Rank every client by score change over a window, worst movers first.

novel_features.name: Exploitability-first patch queue
novel_features.description: Rank software products by exploitability (known-exploited first, then EPSS, then CVSS) with a blast-radius device count and client names resolved.

novel_features.name: CVE blast radius
novel_features.description: List every affected client, device, product, and version for a single CVE id.

novel_features.name: Cure-period breach detector
novel_features.description: Surface compliance events that have blown their event type's remediation window, bucketed by age.

novel_features.name: Silent connector staleness sweep
novel_features.description: Flag connectors that are down, degraded, or reporting healthy while their last sync has gone stale, and name the clients they feed.

novel_features.name: Endpoint coverage gaps
novel_features.description: Diff the devices a connector reports against the devices attributed to the client to expose endpoints one tool sees and another misses.

novel_features.name: Warranty exposure ranking
novel_features.description: Rank unwarranted or lapsed clients by current risk so coverage conversations start with the ones that need it most.

novel_features.name: Exclusion review queue
novel_features.description: List compliance exclusions and silenced alert rules whose review date has passed or that are flagged for review, across every client, oldest first.
